attributes.action: statutory requirement for Aircon in houses
attributes.additional_details: Please sign this petition to make air con statutory requirement for all homes in the UK. With the rising of temperatures in the UK this would help everyone especially our vulnerable adults and children.
attributes.background: Make it a statutory requirement for every home in the UK to have air con this will protect vulnerable adults and children and help everyone who are unable to cope in unbearable heat conditions as the temperatures are rising I believe this should definitely be considered and help our country

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition:

Fund free air-conditioning installation and maintenance in all homes
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/776610
